purpose: Diagnose finite-record native sampling/window-length contribution without replacing the canonical PR #286 observable.

operator.native_sample_interpretation: native sample y[n] is evaluated at t_n=n*dt exactly as in the canonical direct DTFT
operator.endpoint_convention: target interval is exactly [0,T); include native sample timestamps t_n<T; final quadrature width is clipped to T-t_last; no sample at T is included
operator.integration_rule: sum_n Delta_t[n] * y[n] * exp(+i*2*pi*f*t_n), with Delta_t[n]=min(dt,T-t_n); canonical left-rectangle rule is unchanged except the final cell is clipped at T
operator.pressure_sampling: solver-native pressure samples after the pre-existing pressure conversion; no interpolation or resampling
operator.source_sampling: same native source trace and same left-rectangle rule; q[0]=1 retains full dt weight because the first cell is not clipped
operator.reason_linear_trapezoid_not_adopted: The canonical source authority is a discrete unit impulse q[0]=1,q[n>0]=0. Piecewise-linear/trapezoidal endpoint weighting would redefine that impulse area. Clipped left-rectangle weighting preserves every canonical sample/kernel weight except the final record cell, isolating the N*dt-versus-T mismatch.

analytic_fixture.acceptance: relative P_T/Q_T error must strictly decrease at each refinement and finest error must be < 0.11

diagnosis_classification.monotonic_if: aligned second adjacent complex-RMS <= aligned first adjacent complex-RMS
diagnosis_classification.substantially_reduced_if: non-monotone remains but worsening excess ratio ((second/first)-1) is reduced by at least 50% versus canonical
